name: Smoked sausage
summary: Lạp sườn is Cao Bang’s smoked sausage, made on the western road from local black pork.
origin: The eastern road and the western road.
howToEat: Eat it in a bowl of phở chua, beside roast duck and olive sticky rice, or carry it home.
where: The eastern and western roads, and in phở chua in town.
seoTitle: Cao Bang smoked sausage — lap suon
seoDescription: Lạp sườn is Cao Bang’s smoked sausage, made on the western road from local black pork.
